original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿布贾Wassa营地流离失所者感谢CAF与慈善人士捐赠太阳能水井
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿布贾Wassa流离失所者营地获得Civitas Auxilium Foundation（CAF）与慈善人士Otunba Segun Showunmi捐赠的太阳能水井，以改善清洁用水获取。营地负责人称该援助及时，此前居民需前往溪流取水，两个月前曾因霍乱疫情失去三名儿童。CAF执行主任表示该项目旨在为营地妇女和儿童提供可持续用水方案。

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾Wassa流离失所者营地获得CAF与慈善人士捐赠的太阳能水井
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) at Wassa camp, Abuja, have commended the Civitas Auxilium Foundation (CAF) and philanthropist Otunba Segun Showunmi for installing a solar-powered borehole to improve access to clean water.

key_facts.fact: 营地负责人称两个月前因霍乱疫情失去三名儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We even lost three children because of cholera outbreak two months ago.

key_facts.fact: CAF执行主任称营地此前水井损坏且缺乏维护，居民依赖溪流取水
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: before now, the community had a borehole, but it got bad and there was no maintenance, so they depended on the stream

uncertainties: 该事件为单一来源报道，尚未获得其他独立来源交叉验证
